::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 23d [1886]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 161-3:
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Thank you for the Wilberforce extract.

It occurs to me that if the [Jubilee history](cmy_books/cmybook_189.qmd) were put out without illustrations, and with more of the religious element than would be fit for the [English Illustrated Mag.](organizations/other_68.qmd) but would be liked by my own special world of readers, the publication if cheap, might answer /moderately\\. But you will judge when you have looked at the chapters I sent. They go about half way.

You would rejoice me by republishing [the Herb of the Field](cmy_books/cmybook_17.qmd). I should like to have the old copy to look over, for the only one I have was interleaved and illustrated by [my mother](people/person_1606.qmd), and I could not let it go away.

I do not think there is much wrong in it but perhaps I shall think otherwise when I bring critical eyes to it again.  

There are two other sets of papers which I wrote for Mozley’s [Magazine for the Young](organizations/other_79.qmd), and I should like much to see published separately. ‘[<u>Householders</u>](cmy_books/cmybook_357.qmd), which is on shells and quite as entertaining as well as newer than the Herb of the Field, and [<u>Thoughts on Pictures</u>](cmy_books/cmybook_301.qmd) - being descriptions for the youthful mind of notable works of art, and their stories. I  could add a few more.

I think it would <u>tell</u> more now than when it was written - as it was too much beforehand with the cultivation of art.

[Mr W. Smith](people/person_1344.qmd) has all the back vols of the Mag for the Young, where these are.

If you are looking up my old books there are some I should like to resuscitate, if you can find out what became of [Groombridge](organizations/other_148.qmd)’s books (I believe he failed) He had a series of Magnet stories, for which I wrote four[,] three little plays - [<u>the Mice At Play</u>](cmy_books/cmybook_35.qmd), [the <u>Strayed Falcon](cmy_books/cmybook_41.qmd) and [the Apple of Discord</u>](cmy_books/cmybook_54.qmd) - and a story [<u>The Sea Spleenwort</u>](cmy_books/cmybook_46.qmd), each making a little book, for the plays (historical) are embedded in a story.[^1]  I think I had £5 for the copyright of each, but they have never been reprinted and I should think could easily be bought back if they can be traced.

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: These books exist both separately and bound up as *The Magnet Stories*.
